findings: 固定同一个重建器。旧足迹硬裁 138 栋有屋顶，套用旧筛点后 136 栋，周边取点后 142 栋。四栋从无到有，两栋全组均无候选点。
九个街区只有 Brookland 和 Cleveland Park 通过空间留出配准验证，实际移动 24 栋足迹。缓冲新增 34,794 个足迹外候选回波；树冠也可能包含在内。
Boston 222 两个平台在周边取点后都有候选面，但无权重组未选中。软加权后两处都恢复，17 个确认点全部落在选中屋面 0.35 m 内。历史尖墙在本轮六组均未出现。
独立 2022 DC 稳定屋面检查覆盖 3 处、52 点。六组均有 51 点误差不超过 0.35 m。人工复核的 42 个树冠点在六组中均无贴近树冠高度的屋面，暂无法证明软加权减少假平台。
H100 模型在独立 DC 采集上的建筑标签召回率为 88.1%。同批标注点仅保留 20% 邻域回波时，召回从 88.1% 降到 52.9%。222 的 17 个平台点有 15 个被判为植被，软加权后仍可交由几何筛选。
本轮为 1 m NAIP。近红外只对 3 栋的 182 个候选点触发有限降权。样本有局部核查，整体缺少逐栋独立 LoD2 真值和实体闭合认证。

controlled_comparison.coverage_scope: Full-footprint coverage may include low-confidence extension. Success records algorithm output availability, not roof truth.

reviewed_observations.scope: Reviewed return-group support at <=0.35 m in XY-covered surfaces. A group needs >=3 and >=75% fit returns. Vegetation overlap is a canopy-height proxy. The checked-return oracle has incomplete roof coverage, and is for candidate-stage diagnosis.

independent_stable_roof_check.scope: Independent 2022 provider-labelled points within model-blind historical interior roof windows with stable observations. Point locations and heights derive from the independently flown survey, with locally measured ground vertical adjustment. Report only agreed stable interiors; no assumption of unchanged roof over entire building.
restrictions: Stability gate references raw 2014 returns and cannot estimate change rate or population roof accuracy.
No generated model or official roof geometry fed to the stability gate.

case222_false_wall_probe.scope: Observation-derived local height probe at the known Boston 222 wall defect. A missing surface is unresolved and cannot pass this check. The probe diagnoses this defect; it does not measure whole-building geometry accuracy.

rows.probe_source: Eight actual returns near the historical unsupported high wall describe the lower slope. This tests local agreement with the input observations, not independent evidence that all roof structure above them is absent.

independent_survey.scope: Provider labels independently collected Jan 2022 in DC, with manual edits of building labels and automatic vegetation labeling. Building class is a roof proxy that may contain facades. No roof shape or historical target-label inference.

paired_20pct_context.scope: Deterministic independent-survey return thinning at inference. Scores use exactly the same retained point IDs for full and sparse neighborhood context. This synthetic comparison does not model different sensors, leaf conditions, or actual missing swaths.

independent_low_noise_check.scope: Separate check allowing withheld returns. No class 18 high-noise controls were available.
